3755-4770-5301-7296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5641-8166-8181.description:
Cast Proctor of Potential by paying {W}{U}.
When Proctor of Potential enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Proctor of Potential triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

2079-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

323-1981-2292-2415.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

833-907-3827-5607.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace and Klauth can attack without taking damage.
833-907-3827-5607.description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Selesnya Sanctuary, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

282-1479-1671.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Delina (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1263-4871-5686-6112.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4496-5220-5931-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2843-3175.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3094-4659-5295-5390-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4659-5295-5390-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Spider-Byte by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Byte enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Byte trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Vault of Catlacan.

225-539-1460-6845.notes:

Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5010-5708-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

826-2178-3967-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2099-3652-5220-6900.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

38-2316-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
38-2316-6753.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1809-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
1809-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Returned Pastcaller and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Returned Pastcaller, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.

When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

116-4089-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Glasspool Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Glasspool Mimic do not have summoning sickness.
116-4089-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Glasspool Mimic.

Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Glasspool Mimic.
Activate Glasspool Mimic by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

851-939-4404-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor.
When the Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Soul Foundry and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1567-4068-4803-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control at least one Mountain.
1567-4068-4803-5261.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Momentary Blink without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Momentary Blink, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

2034-3058-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Voracious Vermin, adding {C}{C}.
When Voracious Vermin dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Voracious Vermin trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Voracious Vermin from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

6-864-2436-3657.notablePrerequisites: Marwyn does not have summoning sickness and has a power of eight or greater.
6-864-2436-3657.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Cast Vitalize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vitalize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2103-4125-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Shipwreck Dowser.
2103-4125-4305.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
The Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
